redfin.remarks: Welcome to Circle of the Oaks in the highly desirable Friendly Valley, a gated 55+ community offering resort-style living in the heart of Santa Clarita. This spacious and beautifully refreshed home offers 1,562 square feet of comfortable living space, with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a large bonus room with a closet has potential for 3 bedroom or other flex space. Freshly painted in neutral tones, newly carpeted, and featuring brand-new stainless steel appliances, the home is move-in ready and offers a light and inviting interior. The spacious living and dining areas provide an easy-flowing layout, while the kitchen offers ample cabinetry and workspace. The generously sized primary suite provides a comfortable private retreat. The standout feature is the oversized bonus room — a rare and highly versatile space that can be used as a potential third bedroom, guest room, home office, den, hobby or craft room, media room, or additional living area. This flexible space adds tremendous functionality and allows the new owner to tailor the home to their lifestyle. Friendly Valley is more than a neighborhood — it is an active and vibrant 55+ community designed for an enjoyable and social lifestyle. Residents enjoy guard-gated security and an impressive selection of amenities, including two golf courses, a resort-style pool and spa, fitness center , clubhouse , organized social activities, card rooms, library, hobby rooms, lawn bowling, shuffleboard, RV parking, and community transportation. With beautifully maintained grounds and an extensive calendar of clubs, classes, and social gatherings, Friendly Valley offers countless opportunities to stay active and connected. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, medical facilities, and freeway access, this home offers an appealing combination of space, flexibility, fresh updates, and an exceptional active-adult lifestyle.
